title: Vanishing above the dimension on $\mathbf P^1_k$
statement:
Let $k$ be a field and $\mathcal F$ a quasi-coherent
$\mathcal O_{\mathbf P^1_k}$-module. Then
$H^q(\mathbf P^1_k,\mathcal F)=0$ for all $q\geq2$.

proof.text: Use [lem-pc-projective-space-cohomology-bound] with the commutative ring $A=k$, the two-element index type (so $n=1$), and the given quasi-coherent module $\mathcal F$. The projective-space construction in that node is the same $\mathbf P^1_k$ defined by [def-sc-p1-standard], and its cohomology is the functor of [pqf-def-cohomology]. Since $2\le q$ implies $1<q$, the bound gives $H^q(\mathbf P^1_k,\mathcal F)=0$. A zero cohomology object is subsingleton, yielding the stated conclusion.
